credentials.title: Credentials & Online Setup
credentials.restrictedBody: Credentials, online service keys, and setup settings are visible only to the Host owner role.
credentials.secretsHint: Secret values are encrypted in the main process and never read back to the UI, backend, or tournament files.
credentials.fieldTournamentKeyDesc: Per-tournament key for the shared ballot and registration service.
credentials.fieldCdnTokenDesc: Cloudflare Pages token (scoped to Pages: Edit) for publishing the public site and round bundles.
credentials.fieldSmtpDesc: Outgoing mail server used to email private participant links.
credentials.fieldGithubTokenDesc: Fine-grained token (Contents and Pages read/write) for a public GitHub archive repository.
credentials.fieldOwnWorkerTokenDesc: Optional Cloudflare Worker API token when running your own free-tier ballot service.
credentials.validationEmpty: Enter a non-empty value before saving.
credentials.validationSmtp: Fill in host, valid port (1–65535), username, password, and From email.
credentials.unavailable: Credentials service is only available in the Electron desktop app.
credentials.onlineSectionHint: Every online add-on starts Off. Turning one off or encountering an error never blocks offline tabbing.
credentials.noTournamentOnline: Open or create a tournament in Setup to configure per-tournament online switches.
credentials.switchTrustSignedBallots: Trust signed ballots (auto-confirm valid signed QR ballots)
credentials.collectionOnlineQr: Online + QR (portal with Show QR button)
credentials.cdnHostHint: Bare hostname (no https:// or path) encoded into private participant links.
credentials.cdnHostInvalid: Enter a valid bare hostname (for example, wudc2027.pages.dev) with no protocol or path.
credentials.key48hWarning: Request the tournament key at least 48 hours before your event so approval is complete in time.
credentials.stepConnectGithub: 4. Connect GitHub archive (optional; public repository required)
credentials.stepTestPublishM4Note: Checks CDN token locally in M1; live upload arrives in M4.
credentials.pagesHint: Where the public site is uploaded. The account id is the 32-character id on your Cloudflare dashboard; the project is the Pages project name (wudc2027 for wudc2027.pages.dev). The CDN token above must be allowed to edit Pages on this account.
credentials.pagesAccountInvalid: Enter the 32-character Cloudflare account id (letters a–f and digits).
credentials.pagesProjectInvalid: Enter a Pages project name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 58 characters.
credentials.githubRepoHint: owner/name of a public repository the tournament owns, e.g. debate-society/wudc2027-archive. Create it on GitHub with a README so it is not empty. The GitHub token above should be a fine-grained token for this one repository with Contents and Pages read and write.
credentials.githubRepoInvalid: Enter the repository as owner/name, e.g. debate-society/wudc2027-archive.
